lessons.trigger_condition: V382 post-merge core verification passed, but the exact Drive package run remained fail-closed after freshness recovery because collection verification still reported only degraded mandatory outputs caused by transient network or server conditions
lessons.prevention_rule: V383 must keep every production freshness and verification threshold unchanged, permit at most one additional full verified collection cycle only when all remaining high findings are DEGRADED_COLLECTION_OUTPUT on mandatory collectors and every current error is an allowlisted transient timeout, URLError, HTTP 408/425, or HTTP 5xx condition, reject access, rate-limit, retired-source, structural, code, security, or critical failures, then rerun the unchanged package gates and upload only on full success
validation_required: functional candidate commit is exactly f23a48e67a54a90e045bb920bc61a4a76707dc3a
the only V383 watched-path change is .github/workflows/gpt-tcg-drive-package.yml
critical findings always block additional transient recovery
only DEGRADED_COLLECTION_OUTPUT high findings are eligible
eligible targets must belong to mandatory auto_update_all.JOBS
HTTP 401/403/404/410/429 and Retry-After never enter the extra retry path
structural, code, security, permission, SSRF and private-network failures never enter the extra retry path
one additional full verified collection cycle is the maximum package-level transient recovery
the exact production package and collection verification gates rerun after recovery
Drive upload remains conditional on package ready=true
final failures emit bounded redacted diagnostics
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V383 changes only the protected Drive packaging recovery workflow; it does not weaken verification, bypass access controls, upload stale or degraded data, auto-modify source code, write main directly, or claim physical Drive success without evidence
